stories.name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
stories.intro: You reach the top of Nivix, where the great accumulator crackles under an open sky. Niv-Mizzet uncoils from his perch, wings spread over the whole laboratory. He has no patience for a mind that does not inspire him, and he means to test yours with fire.
stories.win: The Dracogenius folds his wings and concedes that you have surprised him. He yields, and his card is yours.
stories.lose: A bolt from the dragon's eye throws you down the spiral stairs of Nivix.
stories.flee: You run for the stairs as his laughter shakes the tower.

stories.name: Frostburn Weird
stories.intro: A chemister's perfect weird has slipped its tank. Half frost and half flame, it hisses steam as it walks. It flares hotter as it rushes you, burning itself thinner to hit harder.
stories.win: The weird cools to a steady glow and drifts after you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Frost and fire hit you at once, and you collapse in the steam.
stories.flee: You slam the lab door, and the weird fogs the glass behind you.

stories.name: Goblin Electromancer
stories.intro: A goblin in a copper harness stands in a ring of humming coils. When asked how much power he needs, he says more. He points a crackling finger at you to find out.
stories.win: The electromancer powers down and offers to make your spells come cheaper. He is yours now.
stories.lose: Lightning arcs from the coils and leaves you twitching on the floor.
stories.flee: You run before the coils finish charging.

stories.name: Izzet Charm
stories.title: A charm with three settings
stories.text: An Izzet guildmage is selling charms from a cart of tangled wire. Each charm has a dial with three settings. She swears none of them explode, then pauses to reconsider.

choices.text: Buy a charm at her price

outcome.text: She wraps the charm in copper foil and wishes you luck.

choices.text: Turn the dial and see what it does

outcome.text: You twist the dial while she looks away.

huge_success.text: The charm hums and shows you two secrets, and the guildmage lets you keep it.

success.text: A spark jumps harmlessly, and the guildmage, delighted, gives you the charm.

failure.text: The charm zaps your hand, and she snatches it back.

huge_failure.text: The cart goes up in a shower of sparks, and you pay for the damage.

outcome.text: You leave her rewiring the cart.

stories.name: Izzet Guildgate
stories.text: A gate of copper and blue glass hums at the edge of an Izzet district, sparking at whoever passes. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
